fit.summary: Seven years of the exact duties (close, AP, payroll) and current QuickBooks Online certification; most recent paid role ended in 2018.

cover_letter.hook: Payables, month-end close, and payroll for a multi-store business are the work I know best, and Oakmont Building Supply's Cedar Rapids office is close to home.
cover_letter.body:
At Whitfield & Grant CPAs I ran month-end close for 12 small-business clients, including bank reconciliations and accruals, and processed biweekly payroll for 9 clients with 180 employees. I once cleared a client's 3-year backlog of unreconciled vendor accounts in 6 weeks.

Before that I paid 400 vendor invoices a month at Prairieland Hardware, matching each one to its purchase order. I hold the QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification, and as volunteer PTO treasurer I kept the books for a $38,000 budget in QuickBooks Online.
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your team splits payables across the 6 stores.

gaps: The CPA and NetSuite are pluses; Laura has neither.
No paid role since 2018. The letter does not explain it; Laura can answer it in an interview if asked.
